name: Form (web component)
summary: A labelled, validated set of fields with no antd: lays out its <aha-form-item>s, validates them on submit and hands you the values.
highlights: validate() and submit() over every item
submit event with { values }, no provider
lead: The framework-free counterpart of the antd Form themed by form-theme.js, for code that cannot reach antd: Vue 2 apps, plain HTML, and React apps dropping antd. It is a plain container, not a native <form>, because a native form cannot see controls slotted through a shadow root; <aha-form> does that job itself. A click on a type="submit" button inside it (<aha-button>, <button> or <input>) or Enter in a one-line text field calls submit(), which validates every <aha-form-item>, focuses the first invalid control and fires submit with { values } or invalid with { values, errors }. A type="reset" button puts every control back. The look is the antd Form's: labels above, 20 between items, the error row under the field, the primary submit as the DS Button.
codeNote: Attributes: layout (vertical | horizontal | inline), required-mark (default the *; optional marks the optional fields instead, with optional-text, default "(optional)"; hidden shows neither). Methods: validate({ focus = true }) resolves to { valid, values, errors: [{ name, label, message }] }; submit() validates and fires submit or invalid, resolving to the same result; reset() restores every control and fires reset. Getters: values ({ [name]: value } over the named items), items. Events (composed, bubbling CustomEvents): submit (detail.values), invalid (detail.values, detail.errors), reset. Controls keep their own state: a React or Vue app may keep driving each control's value; reset() then only matters for uncontrolled fields. Do not nest it in a native <form>. In React 18 listen through a ref (addEventListener('submit')); React 19 takes onSubmit.

spec.label: Vertical
spec.value: default: items stacked, label above each control, 20 between items (antd layout vertical + form-theme itemMarginBottom 20)

spec.label: Horizontal
spec.value: labels in a 160 column (--aha-form-label-width) beside the control, centred on the 40 control row

spec.label: Inline
spec.value: items on one wrapping row, 16 apart, label beside the control

spec.label: Submit
spec.value: the DS <aha-button type="submit" variant="primary">, one per form; Enter in a one-line text field submits too

spec.label: Validation
spec.value: on submit every item; on leaving a field after an edit; again on each edit while its error shows. The first invalid control takes focus, its error describes it

props.name: required-mark
props.desc: Default shows * on required labels; optional marks the optional ones instead; hidden shows neither

props.name: optional-text
props.desc: The optional mark's text; pass translated text

props.name: validate()
props.desc: Runs every item's rules and shows the results

props.name: submit()
props.desc: Validates, then fires submit or invalid

props.name: reset()
props.desc: Restores every control's first value, clears errors, fires reset

props.name: invalid
props.desc: A rule failed; detail.values and detail.errors (antd onFinishFailed)

whenToUse.when: two or more related fields submitted together, from code that cannot reach antd: Vue 2, plain HTML, React without antd
a React or Vue 3 app that already themes antd with form-theme.js
one value that applies on its own, with no submit step
a settings surface that saves as it changes

opinion.note: One primary submit per form, named for what it does ("Send invite", not "Submit"). Validate on leaving a field and on submit; say how to fix the error under the field. Keep the vertical layout on narrow surfaces.

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form: a version-pinned CDN import and plain HTML, no build step.
